Controls

How to ride

Keyboard for riding, touchpad or mouse for the mountain cam and the orbit camera.

AD or ←→
Carve left and right. In the air: spin.
W / ↑
Tuck for speed. In the air: frontflip. On flats: skate.
S / ↓
Skid to slow down. In the air: backflip.
Space
Hold to crouch, release to ollie. Release right at the edge of a kicker lip for a perfect pop: more speed and height. Jump off rails.
Rails and boxes
Touch one and you snap on. Keep the balance needle near the middle with A and D: it wanders off on its own. Let it reach the edge and you slip off.
Q / F
Press the front or back of the board into the snow. Add A or D to butter-spin on it. Ollie off a nose press for a nollie.
On a rail
W switches up 180, S switches between 50-50 and boardslide, Q / F press for nose and tail slides. Spin onto a rail and off it for 270-ons and spin-outs.
JKLI
Grabs: Indy, Melon, Tail, Nose. Hold two for Method, Japan, Stalefish, Mute, Crail or Truck Driver; hold longer to tweak. Let go before you land. Spin and flip together for corks, rodeos and mistys.
C
Slow motion with an orbit camera. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
R
Respawn at your last safe spot.
E
Ride the lift you're standing at.
M
Open the mountain cam (trail map).
N
Music on or off.
Esc / P
Pause.
Mountain cam
Hover a lift to highlight it, click to choose. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag or QE to rotate.
